name: NORMAN Suspect List Exchange -- SusDat (S0)
notes: OPERA-model-predicted ESI mode, precursor M+H+/M-H- mass, and chromatography platform recommendation. These are model predictions over a suspect list, not measured method parameters -- always shown as predicted, never as a confirmed method.

name: NORMAN Suspect List Exchange -- EAWAGTPS (S66)
owner: Eawag and contributing organisations, via NORMAN Association
notes: Real, curated parent/transformation-product pairs -- each entry is a documented pair, never a predicted transformation. EnviroChem ships a static snapshot; re-run scripts/convert_norman_references.py against a newer Zenodo release to update it.

name: MassBank Europe
notes: Real, measured MS2 product-ion spectra plus the chromatography metadata (RT, column, mobile phase, ionisation mode) recorded with each spectrum. Live-verified 2026-09-08 against https://massbank.eu/MassBank-api/records?inchi_key=... . A record's own instrument/method fields describe the conditions that specific spectrum was measured under, not a universal recommended method.

name: NIST Tandem Mass Spectral Library
owner: National Institute of Standards and Technology
notes: Distributed as paid desktop software (NIST MS Search / library files), not a queryable API. EnviroChem registers it as a known source without scraping or embedding any of its data.

name: mzCloud
notes: Web search UI only; no open programmatic access for third-party integration. Registered as a known source, not scraped.

name: METLIN
notes: Full spectral access requires a licensed instrument-vendor library agreement. Registered as a known source, not scraped.
